outcome: Safety (side effects like nausea, abdominal pain)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women diagnosed with moderate anemia between 14 and 36 weeks of gestation, randomly divided into two groups.
finding: Ferric carboxymaltose was found to be more efficient with no life-threatening reactions compared to iron sucrose complex for treating moderate iron deficiency anemia in pregnant women at 14-36 weeks of gestation.
